The initial measurement is close to the selected date, rather than exactly at midnight. Its actual time is shown above.
No measurement exactly at the end of the period. Unused energy is an estimate based on the last measurement before the deadline.
The last measurement is over 15 minutes old. This is the last known balance.
Remove this local reserve and its saved readings?
Reserve balance from the settlement invoice (kWh)
Dates use the Europe/Warsaw time zone.
Enter the cumulative grid import reading at the start of this period, summed across all three phases. This is a meter reading, separate from the allowance on your bill.
Search readings near the requested midnight and explicitly confirm one. You can set any search date range. The actual date, time and counter value are shown before saving.
Saving replaces the current configuration and recalculates the entire period from the new initial counter.
Allowances are settlement estimates stored on this phone. Reconcile the next invoice by editing the period and invoice allowance; allowances are not rolled over automatically.
This meter is no longer available in the active account.
Account changed. Reopen the meter to load the correct reserve.
Cannot read or save the local configuration. Retry, or remove this reserve and configure it again.
Could not retrieve measurements. Any displayed balance uses the last saved measurement. Check your connection and retry.
Enter a positive allowance in kWh, with at most five decimal places.
Enter a non-negative cumulative initial counter in kWh, with at most five decimal places.
The last day of validity must be on or after the first day.
No suitable historical reading is available. Enter the initial counter manually if configuring the reserve.
Complete active import counters for all three phases are required. Check the meter history.
The measurement is outside the period or older than the saved one. The saved balance has been retained.
No readings in this range. Change the dates or enter the initial counter manually.
Choose and confirm a historical reading within the validity period, or enter the initial counter manually.
Check the period and search dates. The search end cannot precede its start.
Readings are limited to the selected dates, before the validity deadline and no later than now.
Exported to the grid after hourly balancing
Energy accumulated in the previous billing period is used first, followed by energy from the current period.
Estimate: hour boundaries and history gaps were reconstructed from available measurements. See data quality for details.

We balance import and export within each hour from midnight on the first day. Balanced import reduces the invoice allowance. If enabled, the second reserve accumulates balanced exports after the selected deduction. The initial history download may take longer.
Configure hourly balancing to calculate energy earned since the first day of the period.
No readings are available to begin calculating the selected period. Check the dates and history availability. The previous result is retained.
This mode requires import and export counters for all three phases. Missing values are not replaced with zero.
The result covers only the available range. Unknown energy at the beginning or end was not assumed to be zero. Check the history details.

Estimates preserve import and export increments between readings. The hourly distribution in a gap is unknown, so the balance may differ from the actual settlement. Gap details show complete intervals between readings, including intervals partly outside the period.
Missing beginning: %1$s → %2$s. Calculations begin at the first available reading.
No completed data after: %1$s. The remaining period awaits readings.
Incomplete readings skipped: %1$d. Increments were reconstructed between complete readings where available.
No recorded gaps longer than one hour. Hour boundaries may still be interpolated from nearby readings.
Increment between readings: import %1$s kWh, export %2$s kWh.
Method: matching-hour profile from nearby days.
Mixed method: hourly profile and uniform distribution for counters without sufficient profile data.
If missing measurements appeared later, recalculate all history to replace earlier estimates. This preserves the invoice allowance and selected deduction.

Without hourly balancing we count all import and export across the three phases from the first day of the period. The selected deduction applies only to new exports. The invoice allowance is used first.
No hourly balancing — full import and export
Estimated balance for the available part of the period. Beginning or ending data is missing.
The initial counter state was estimated from nearby readings.
Total energy will be available after a valid measurement.

Enabled: for each completed hour, subtract exported energy from imported energy across all three phases. Only net import or export remains. Example: 5 kWh imported and 3 kWh exported leaves 2 kWh of import. Missing history can make the result approximate.

Disabled: use cumulative meter increases since the period start or selected reading. All import reduces the reserve, without subtracting exports from the same hour. If the second reserve is enabled, all export adds to it after the 20% or 30% deduction.

In both modes, import uses the previous reserve first, then the current reserve. The invoice balance already includes the deduction and is not reduced again. With the second reserve disabled, exports do not create a new allowance.
